versions.changelog:
No user-facing changes detected in this release.

- Version number and documentation remain unchanged.
- No code or documentation file updates found.

Major upgrade with CLI tool migration, new workflows, and stricter user output:

- Migrated CLI tool to new `rgh` binary; all commands now routed via `scripts/rgh.js` (Node) or `scripts/rgh.py` (Python).
- Strict new output rules: never reveal command-line/JSON/technical details; only show user-facing hotel info (name, price, facilities, booking link) in formatted cards.
- Full install support for Node, Python, or direct binary download, with clear upgrade requirements if CLI version is outdated.
- Added daily version check logic: prompts upgrade if newer remote SKILL.md detected.
- All CLI parameters are now discovered dynamically via `--help` before each command, ensuring up-to-date arguments.
- Enhanced booking workflow and security confirmation, with Markdown templates for hotel/search result display.
- Chinese-language documentation and command triggers broadened for full-featured hotel workflow.

- Skill name changed from rollinggo-hotel to rollinggo-searchhotel.
- Environment variable for API key updated from AIGOHOTEL_API_KEY to RollingGo_API_KEY.
- Added a new section on version freshness, specifying that the latest release of rollinggo is always used on every run.
- No other functional changes.
